source_name: SMIDA кабінет клієнта / nonres.smida.gov.ua (client and non-resident cabinets)
why_relevant: The filing-side cabinets used by issuers and by non-resident entities. Not a content source in itself, but it confirms the submission channel and the existence of a distinct non-resident track — relevant when a foreign payments group's Ukrainian vehicle files here.

source_name: old.bank.gov.ua — legacy bank directory search (Довідник банківських установ, що мають ліцензію)
why_relevant: Legacy NBU portal still hosting the searchable licensed-institution directory and historical pages; useful for archival lookups and for records that were not migrated to the current site.

source_name: Prozorro mirror/aggregator marketplaces (Playtender, tender.uub.com.ua and other authorised e-platforms)
why_relevant: Authorised Prozorro e-marketplaces and tender aggregators re-index the same procurement data with friendlier category browsing (e.g. a dedicated 'Банкомати' DK021 30123200-9 category listing). Useful as a redundant access path when the central portal's search or API is rate-limited, and for category-level discovery of vendor names.

Accredited ProZorro marketplaces whose public tender pages are heavily indexed by search engines, making them a practical discovery route to banking-services lots (e.g. UCEQE bank RKO tender) and to buyer-organisation pages listing all of an entity's tenders.

source_name: Аудиторська палата України (АПУ) — professional self-regulatory body
why_relevant: AПУ is the professional organisation of Ukrainian auditors (certification, standards, member base). Post-2023 the register moved to APOB, so АПУ is now a secondary/contextual source — useful for membership, certification and market-structure context, not as the authoritative register.

source_name: Baker Tilly Ukraine — audit practice site (bank engagement evidence)
why_relevant: Mid-tier firm with documented Ukrainian bank audit engagements (e.g. its signed opinion appears in Bank Globus statements). Useful for auditor→bank attribution outside the Big Four and as a snowball seed for further mid-tier firms.

source_name: Bankografo+ — портрет банку (Сенс Банк та ін.)
why_relevant: Ukrainian bank-analytics portal presenting per-bank normalised financials — a cross-check layer when issuer PDFs are hard to parse; note legacy 'alfa-bank' slug for Sense Bank reflects the pre-rebrand identity.
Another PIE-capable network firm in Ukraine; needed to complete the auditor population beyond Big Four + GT. Transparency-report page not located in this pass.

source_name: Bloomberg LEI lookup — mirror of LEI records (example: АТ «ОТП БАНК»)
why_relevant: Third-party LOU-operated LEI viewer that mirrors GLEIF records for Ukrainian banks (e.g. OTP Bank, LEI 5299003XXPWL6O33R633, registration authority National Bank of Ukraine). Useful as a fallback view when GLEIF endpoints are rate-limited, and confirms NBU as the registration authority used in LEI records for UA banks.

Consumer-finance portal and community with bank news, rates and a large forum; the forum is a weak-signal channel for service outages, PSP behaviour and customer-side changes that precede formal disclosure.

Insurance/finance trade portal republishing a bank reliability ranking; low independent value but a useful triangulation point and an entry into insurance-sector coverage that touches bancassurance and payments.

source_name: Member-bank DGF disclosure pages (mandatory depositor-information publication)
why_relevant: Every DGF member bank is required to publish standardised information about the deposit guarantee system. Collectively these pages act as a distributed, timestamped index of who was a member when — and a bank quietly amending or removing its DGF page can be an early signal of status change. Low-value individually, useful as a cross-check panel.

entity_name: Ukrainian partner-bank pages describing IFI programmes
source_name: Ukrainian partner-bank pages describing IFI programmes (e.g. Ukreximbank EBRD programme page)
why_relevant: Ukrainian banks publish their own Ukrainian-language descriptions of IFI facilities (ЄБРР, ЄІБ, МФК, Світовий банк lines) including limits, tenors and eligible borrowers. This is the mirror image of the IFI disclosure and reveals terms and local naming the IFI page omits; Ukreximbank also hosts archived World Bank project documents in Ukrainian.

Accredited-marketplace ecosystem site mirroring ProZorro tenders with its own search and an analytical blog (e.g. on selling state-bank property through Prozorro.Продажі). Useful as an alternate index when the central portal search is limiting.
